discovery: No fitting: H539 discovery identity-map signs frozen. Coefficient sign comes from each native prompt before intervention.
fresh_design: Operation x format: narrative binding, list binding, narrative copying, list copying. Eight shared name pairs. Primary cells matched within format on final/source tokens and their positions, with Note padding fixed by tokenizer. Additional reversed binding list and temporal copying narrative reported.
gate: At least four pairs, >=75% both-endpoint candidate correctness, >=50% full-vocabulary top1.
decomposition: Unweighted core = output_head @ (initial value_after-initial value_before). Identity alignment = (unembedding_after-unembedding_before) dot core. Coefficient = native attention pattern summed over changed source positions * bus_mix. Residual gain for frozen final effect reported separately.
causal_test: Replace the changed source-position bus contribution of one head by gate_scale times a third-token value. All downstream computation remains live. Gate sign reversal changes only this source-to-head bus contribution, not whole attention or QK.
third_test: Only native gate +1; fixed-map sign times native coefficient predicts third-token contrast. No gate-reversal or zero-gate condition in this run.
scope: Head/source interventions, not replacement of all bus uses. No necessity or population claim.
matched_scope: All conditions intervene only on the last changed name position. Primary narrative/list cells pair exactly across operations in source and final positions. Narrative binding anchors reused; other prompts newly composed.
hypothesis: Operation-linked gate predicts identity suppression in both binding formats and copying in both copy formats. Pure prose/list heuristic predicts format-linked signs. All native competence and intervention results reported without selection.
